# Archived invalid push workflows (2026-10-14)

These 13 legacy workflows were selected from GitHub Actions **push runs that
failed before creating any job** on the reviewed commit. Their original content
is retained unchanged here; moving them outside `.github/workflows/` prevents
further automatic runs of these broken definitions. These are NOT patient data.

For rollback, move any selected workflow back into `.github/workflows/` only
after fixing and validating its YAML. The working print V2 workflow remains
active. No other workflows were archived.
